summary: mfacord executes remote JavaScript fetched from obfuscated host on require (Windows)
details: On require of mfacord, lib/http.js schedules an immediate HTTPS GET whose destination host and path are reconstructed at runtime by XOR-decoding base64 buffers (_pool.ns and _RV.r1 XORed with key 91), resolving to limbomail.com with an /api/attachment/... path. The fetched response body is emitted via process.emit('pool:ready', v) and handled in lib/cache.js, which locates Module.prototype._compile by scanning prototype property names for one starting with '_' and of length 8 (avoiding a literal '_compile'/'eval'/'Function' string) and then invokes it on the network-sourced string via Reflect.apply, executing attacker-controlled JavaScript inside the installer's Node process. The network destination is concealed via XOR/base64 obfuscation and the code-evaluation sink is looked up by charCode/length probe, both consistent with deliberate evasion rather than any documented MFA/TOTP functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
